product_summary: Website (clearsynth.com, sitemap-categories.xml) shows three business verticals: (1) Standards — working/reference standards, impurities, degradation products, stable-isotope-labelled internal standards, metabolites, nitrosamine standards, pesticide standards, glucuronides; (2) API — generic APIs, building blocks, intermediates, heterocyclics, carbohydrates, peptides, chiral compounds, catalysts, ligands, natural products; (3) d-CDMO — deuterated and non-deuterated custom synthesis. Catalogue categories include Deuterated Reagents (36 parent compounds: acetophenone, alanine, valine, phenylalanine, tryptophan, benzene, aniline, bromo/chloropyridines, cyclohexanone, cyclopentanone, citric/succinic/lauric/octanoic/trifluoroacetic acid, diethylamine, pyrrolidine, D2O 'dideuterium dioxide', dipotassium deuterium phosphate, sulfuric acid, hydride, ether, ketone, alcohol, alkane), Inorganics (21 parents: ammonium, barium, boron, calcium phosphate, chromium, copper, ferric acid, germanium, lithium, magnesium chloride, manganese, oxaliplatin, phosphoric acid, potassium bromate/chloride/fluoride dihydrate, rhenium, ruthenium, tetrazole), plus NMR Solvent, Solvent, Reagents, Stable Isotopes, Fluorinated Compounds, Insecticides, Ligands, Secondary Standards. Core business is small-volume, high-value research/analytical chemistry (mg–kg), not bulk petrochemicals.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — claims own synthesis/manufacturing (d-CDMO, API programmes, Hyderabad Innovation Center, IDA Mallapur) but catalogue is largely a reseller/standards-catalogue model with custom synthesis on request; both functions present.
comment: Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is a pharma/analytical-standards and stable-isotope chemistry house, not an oil & gas or petrochemical supplier. Declared HS set (281122 silicon dioxide; 290242 toluene; 290420 nitro-hydrocarbon derivatives; 291219 acyclic aldehydes) is only partially consistent with the catalogue. 281122 could correspond to silica/inorganic lines but no silica product is visible in the Inorganics list (ammonium, barium, boron, calcium phosphate, chromium, copper, ferric acid, germanium, lithium, magnesium chloride, manganese, oxaliplatin, phosphoric acid, potassium bromate/chloride/fluoride, rhenium, ruthenium, tetrazole) — so 281122 is not corroborated. 290242 (toluene) and 290420 fit only if sold as deuterated NMR solvents/derivatives; the catalogue does list NMR Solvent and deuterated benzene/alkane/ketone lines, so partial plausibility but no explicit toluene or nitro-compound entry seen. 291219 (acyclic aldehydes) has no visible counterpart in the catalogue. The dominant real trade — reference standards, impurities, metabolites, deuterated/stable-isotope compounds, amino acids, heterocyclics, APIs — falls under 3822, 2845, 2934, 2942, 2922, 2914/2915/2921, none of which appear in the declaration. Recommendation per project rule 3: keep the company, correct the HS set to the actual product lines (38229090, 28459000, 29349990, 29420090, 29224990, 29142990, 29152990, 29211990, 29039990, 28111990/28352990), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data above is from the company's own website catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line was checked in this task (customs/volumes out of scope). No revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment data researched or asserted here; PAN AADCC9150H and Telangana state claim not verified in this task. Note: registered office shown on site is Mumbai (17, Lotus Business Park, Andheri West), with an Innovation Center in Hyderabad, Telangana — the Telangana state claim is consistent only with the Hyderabad site, not the registered address.
